acceptance.given: An existing account-owned historical snapshot is captured as the baseline manifest and digest before isolated rename and delete write attempts.

oracle.expected: The snapshot storage boundary rejects both rename and delete attempts with an immutable-state error, and a subsequent read returns the same manifest entries, file bytes, and digest as the pre-attempt baseline.
forbidden: A rename attempt mutates historical state.
A delete attempt mutates historical state.
oracle.observable: The integration test invokes each write attempt, observes rejection, then reads the historical snapshot and compares manifest metadata and content hashes byte-for-byte with the captured baseline.

acceptance.then: Historical state remains available and unchanged for later read or replay operations.
acceptance.when: A caller attempts to rename or delete a path belonging to historical snapshot state.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the historical snapshot rename-attempt test; fail when the operation succeeds, returns a non-immutability outcome, or changes the stored manifest or content digest.
Run the historical snapshot delete-attempt test; fail when the operation succeeds, returns a non-immutability outcome, or changes the stored manifest or content digest.
Run the baseline capture/readback assertion; fail when the historical manifest, metadata, or content digest cannot be deterministically compared before and after each rejected write.

affected_subjects: Account-owned historical snapshot state and its rename/delete write boundary
slice_hint.behavior_change: Make historical snapshot paths explicitly immutable for rename and delete attempts, returning deterministic rejection while preserving existing snapshot data and readback.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema migration or data rewrite; rollback only the write-rejection guard, with existing historical manifests and bytes remaining readable.

slice_hint.state_transition: historical snapshot baseline captured -> rename/delete attempt rejected -> identical manifest, metadata, and content digest observed
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Both isolated rename and delete attempts are rejected, and historical snapshot state is byte-for-byte and metadata-identical to its captured baseline.
